title: PostgreSQL master node storage corruption and table lock
summary: Database disk array failure caused table corruption on transaction primary node.
root_cause: Hardware disk failure on primary DB node.
action_items: Executed WAL restore script pitr_restore.go to point-in-time recovery

title: API Gateway 504 Gateway Timeout spike following release
summary: Upstream timeout breach caused 504 errors on payment gateway endpoint.
root_cause: Unindexed database query in payment status check handler.
action_items: Rolled back API deployment to previous release tag

title: Merchant payout webhook delivery failure backlog
summary: Webhook queue worker stalled due to connection pool exhaustion.
root_cause: Partner API endpoint slow response times without connection timeout.
action_items: Enforced 5s timeout on external HTTP client

title: Kubernetes ingress controller certificate renewal failure
summary: TLS certificate expiration warning triggered automated incident alert.
root_cause: Let's Encrypt cert-manager API rate limit.

title: Partner bank settlement file format mismatch
summary: Partner bank introduced unannounced header column in daily settlement CSV.
root_cause: Vendor format change without schema notification.

title: [Legacy] Bank statement parser memory leak during midnight batch processing
summary: Large MT940 statement file caused OOM kill on parser worker.
root_cause: Buffering entire 500MB statement file into memory.

title: Canary deployment traffic shifting stalling at 10%
summary: Argo Rollouts controller failed to promote canary release automatically.
root_cause: Metric provider query timeout during latency check.

title: PostgreSQL read replica replication lag breach (>60s)
summary: Heavy analytical query on read replica caused replication slot delay.
root_cause: Long-running report query blocking WAL apply worker.
action_items: Isolated analytics reporting to dedicated read pool

title: High HTTP 429 rate on merchant payment intent API
summary: Legitimate high-volume merchant triggered false positive rate limit.
root_cause: Static IP rate limit bucket shared across multi-tenant API key.
action_items: Updated rate limit key from IP to API key identifier
